page.layout: One page of text. Running head top centre, page number top left. Left margin holds marginal notes beside the first paragraphs. Main text in one column, with a centred title "IMPERIUM INDIÆ." and small labels "Canon." and "Explic." above their passages.

main_text.head: Explicatio §.
main_text.p: Bastria-nis & Parthis originē deuc-runt, In hac expeditione Scythæ Bactrianis & Parthis originem dederunt: quippe Scytharum pars reliqua in Persia & Media tandem in Parthorum & Bactrianorum prævalidas nationes excreverunt.
main_text.head: IMPERIUM INDIÆ.
Canon.
main_text.p: (4) Indicum. India in plura regna distracta fuit.
main_text.head: Explic.
main_text.p: fundatū a Baccho Indorum Imperium conditum traditur a Baccho, quicunq; tandem is fuerit; post quem 153. ordine reges regnasse tradunt, quorum nec quidem nomina nota sunt. Mentio unius tantum fit Regis Stawrobatos [?], qui bellum contra Semiramidem gessisse dicitur. India igitur incogni-

page.notes: The left margin notes are small and partly cut off at the left edge: "Bactria-" is read as "Bastria-" with the long s, and "deuc-runt" is uncertain (possibly "dederunt"). The word "Stawrobatos" is marked [?] because its letters are hard to read. "Indorum Imperium conditum" is copied as it appears. The text ends at "incogni-", which continues on the next page.
